summary: Iteration 33 — Revision Workflow validated end-to-end. Backend pytest 18/18 green: request-revision validation (short justification 422, invalid priority 400, non-employer 403, non-submitted deliverable 400), full penalty ladder on ONE deliverable (rev#3 → talent.under_review + revision_flags[under_review]; rev#5 → excessive_revisions=true, visibility_score 100→80, rate_bias_pct=-10, dispute_available=true), /api/talent demotes excessive_revisions talent to bottom and revokes is_trusted_partner, resubmit transitions status revision_requested→revision_resubmitted and stamps latest revision (resubmit_link/hours/notes/status='resubmitted'), revisions thread reachable for employer/talent/admin (403 for unrelated user), dispute<5 revisions → 400, dispute ≥5 creates grievance with kind='revision_dispute' + $49 fee + full revision_thread, duplicate dispute blocked, /admin/revisions returns counts+revisions+disputes (403 non-admin), admin rule='talent' sets fee.status='owed_by_employer' AND lifts excessive_revisions/under_review/visibility resets to 100/rate_bias 0, employer abuse-flag stamps profile.abusive_pattern_flag after ≥5 revisions on 3 distinct talents and appears in /admin/employers-flagged (talent → 403). Frontend admin console: [data-testid=admin-tab-revisions] present, click renders [data-testid=admin-revisions-panel] with 3 stat tiles (Open revisions=26, Open disputes=0, Flagged employers=1), Disputes queue lists REVDIS-* refs, Open revision cycles enumerated, seeded flagged employer visible — confirming full backend↔frontend wiring.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/revisions.py `_load_deliverable_and_authorize` returns before the admin branch when the current user is BOTH employer and (say) talent on some other deliverable — harmless in practice but the role check leaks: employer_id/talent_id are user ids, so this only matters if the same user id ever holds two roles. Safe today.

routes/revisions.py admin_rule_dispute: when ruling='employer' the endpoint does NOT re-affirm the talent penalty (which is fine because it was set at rev#5), but it also does NOT close the deliverable's open revision cycle. Deliverable can be left stuck in 'revision_requested' forever with talent still penalised — consider auto-closing or letting talent re-submit even after a rejected dispute.
routes/revisions.py list_revisions caps at 50 items — a truly abusive employer thread could exceed this. Not blocking, but consider paginating.
server.py /api/talent sort key uses `x.get('excessive_revisions') or False` — good, but it does NOT tie-break within the excessive group. Purely cosmetic.

Register endpoint enforces a hard allowlist on company_industry, and the values in /app/memory/test_credentials.md (`Series-B fintechs`) are no longer in the accepted list (`Financial Services & Fintech`, …). Tests worked around this by omitting the industry — main agent should refresh the test-credentials file to match the current EMPLOYER_INDUSTRIES.
routes/revisions.py DISPUTE_FEE_USD is a float — serialized as 49.0 in JSON; matches the spec's '$49' but consider int for cleaner UI.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (admin revisions tab + panel + stat tiles + disputes queue verified)

test_credentials: admin@talenthub.io/Admin@2026, emp-series-b-fintechs@test.io/Employer@2026, talent@test.io/Talent@2026; test file registers throwaway TEST_i33_* accounts per run.
seed_data_creation: Test run creates one employer (TEST_i33_employer_*) with 500 hours (via /admin/users/{id}/adjust), 8+ talents (TEST_i33_talent_*), 5+ engagements + deliverables driven to rev#5 to exercise the ladder, and 1 resolved revision_dispute grievance. All rows are prefixed TEST_i33 for easy cleanup.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 33 endpoints live in /app/backend/routes/revisions.py: POST /api/deliverables/{id}/request-revision (employer), POST /api/deliverables/{id}/resubmit (talent, replaces old resubmit), GET /api/deliverables/{id}/revisions (parties + admin moderation), POST /api/deliverables/{id}/dispute (talent, ≥5 revs), GET /api/admin/revisions (moderation), POST /api/admin/revisions/{gid}/rule (moderation, ruling=talent|employer), GET /api/admin/employers-flagged (moderation), GET /api/deliverables/{id}/revision-summary (button-gating probe). Config env knobs: REVISION_REVIEW_THRESHOLD (3), REVISION_PENALTY_THRESHOLD (5), REVISION_DISPUTE_FEE_USD (49), REVISION_VISIBILITY_PENALTY (20), REVISION_RATE_NUDGE_PENALTY (10), EMPLOYER_FLAG_UNIQUE_TALENTS (3), EMPLOYER_FLAG_WINDOW_DAYS (60). Frontend testids all present and wired: admin-tab-revisions, admin-revisions-panel, admin-revisions-list, rule-talent-<gid>, rule-employer-<gid>, request-revision-<id>, revision-modal, revision-justification, revision-submit, resubmit-<id>, resubmit-modal, resubmit-link, resubmit-hours, resubmit-notes, resubmit-submit, dispute-<id>, dispute-modal, dispute-reason, dispute-submit, excessive-revisions-<id> (BrowseTalent ribbon).
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found. One environment gotcha: /app/memory/test_credentials.md still references the older EMPLOYER_INDUSTRIES vocabulary ('Series-B fintechs'), which no longer round-trips through /auth/register. Non-blocking for this iteration but worth updating.
